acceptance_criteria.description: Define a reproducible, non-destructive HID capture procedure covering required USB/HID metadata, descriptors, reports, controls, and report lengths.
Define the target-device and connection-mode capture matrix for ELECOM DEFT and ELECOM HUGE PLUS without inventing the DEFT model number or results.
Define deterministic evidence naming and schema that separates observed bytes from interpretation and annotation.
Define explicit checks against the KQM constraints identified in Task 001 and cite their repository evidence.
Document the Feather USB host safety boundary for GP16/GP17 and the evidence process for GP18 VBUS polarity and timing without guessing.
State explicitly that Task 002 does not prove DEFT or HUGE PLUS compatibility and that later hardware evidence is required.
Maintain valid loop state and append-only iteration evidence for Task 002.
